entities.title: Internals
entities.summary: The machinery behind structural validation (a strict JSON reader and a JSON Schema interpreter for the embedded UTV schema), and the shared helpers of the everyday operations in Everyday/.
entities.purpose: Reads JSON text strictly into its own node tree (StrictJson), so duplicate keys, lone surrogates and excessive depth are caught, and checks that tree against schema/utv-1.0.schema.json with an interpreter of exactly the keywords that schema uses (SchemaInterpreter). UtvValidator is the public face of both.
boundaries: Internal to the Utv assembly; UtvValidator and GregorianCivil in the parent folder are the public entrypoints.
The schema is the repository's file, embedded at build time; nothing here edits or copies it.
Reads no clock, host time zone or culture.
